wake.prompt: Production 2D action game VFX animation spritesheet, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Exactly 12 distinct consecutive animation frames in a clean regular 4-column by 3-row grid, chronological left to right top to bottom. No grid lines, labels, text, characters, objects, scenery, checkerboard, black matte, borders, or UI. Generous empty transparent gutters; each effect remains strictly inside its own equal cell, same camera and spatial registration throughout. Style: premium hand-painted magical sword combat, crisp ivory-white energy cores, layered champagne-gold filaments, small pale cyan lightning details, airy translucent gray vapor. High definition organic evolving shapes, restrained bloom so each filament and shard is readable. One complete animation evolving through preparation, release, impact or peak, and dissipation; each frame must have a truly different drawn silhouette and internal flow, NOT the same picture resized, rotated, recolored, or opacity-faded. Fine details must read at game scale. Single effect type only. Effect: a spectacular horizontal lightning dash wake travelling toward the RIGHT. All frames use square cells; fixed leading edge at x=78% and y=52% of cell, long tapered tail to the LEFT. There is NO person, sword, vehicle or projectile. Frames 1-2: compressed intertwined ivory/gold arcs gathering near leading edge. 3-4: energetic needle-stream ribbons unwind left with two tiny electric branches. 5-7: strongest long sweeping white-gold thrust wake, ribbon-like ribbons crossing into an elegant layered lightning tunnel, torn pale blue wisps, crisp shardlets. 8-9: wake shears into elongated separated streaks. 10-11: streaks fracture into sparse dissipating curls and gold flecks. 12: a few tiny isolated ember specks. Avoid thick neon blue clouds, dirty fuzzy noise, solid straight speed-line triangles, opaque yellow blobs, fire. The trail should look rich and kinetic yet light, gold dominant with white center. Canvas aspect 4:3.
